project: Black & White Zebra application response video

sourceRegistry.normalization: Exact founder instruction, trimmed, UTF-8, no trailing newline. The private instruction body is excluded from this public receipt.

observations.observation: An externally assembled source set passed technical gates and founder playback after phrase-safe trims, restrained overlays, colour matching, audio mastering and delivery checks.
observations.frameworkEffect: Generation and deterministic post-production are separate contracts.

observations.observation: A later high-motion edit passed author deterministic QA, then a founder instruction rejected that edit layer and required a rebuild from the accepted v4.1 sources.
observations.frameworkEffect: Machine integrity, independent craft review and founder acceptance are separate release gates.

observations.observation: Source clips with dialogue, identity or material lip-sync failure required regeneration; clean gaps, terminal tails and mix differences could be edited only with re-audit.
observations.frameworkEffect: The post-flight decision distinguishes regeneration from bounded salvage.

observations.observation: A single-line overlay clipped its final word despite looking acceptable in summary views and was repaired as a balanced multi-line composition.
observations.frameworkEffect: Overlay acceptance requires rendered-pixel review at output resolution.

observations.observation: Source identity could not be trusted to filename order because generated downloads used inconsistent names.
observations.frameworkEffect: Source identity is transcript plus SHA-256 plus stable source ID.

observations.observation: Later semantic and cinematic B-roll experiments passed author checks but did not receive independent and founder approval.
observations.frameworkEffect: They remain failure and exploration evidence, not recommended defaults.

claimCeiling: This receipt supports framework controls for one production lineage. It does not claim universal provider compliance or audience-performance improvement.
